releases.notes:
This update has a wand that can transform the following blocks:
DIRT -> OBSIDIAN,
SANDSTONE -> TNT,
RED SANDSTONE -> TNT,
SAND -> GLASS,
RED SAND -> GLASS,
BOOKSHELF -> ENCHANTING TABLE,
COBBLESTONE -> STONE,
CLAY -> BRICKS,
PUMPKIN -> JACK O` LANTERN,
NETHERRACK -> NETHER_BRICKS

You can craft it with 1 stick and 1 flint.

releases.notes:
This is the initial release for my minecraft mod. Probably gonna start porting it to new mc versions now.
This was kinda a big jump from v0.3 so here's everything that's happened since then.

v0.3.1 op armor & op diamond ore (enchanted armor and diamonds drop a lot of diamonds and have a chance to drop netherite ingots)
v0.3.1.1 easy obsidian (all obsidian always drop 1 stack)
v0.3.2 obsidian lava (all obsidian within a 5 block radius will be turned into obsidian Only in the nether)
v0.3.3 easy blaze rods (upon entering the nether you get 16 ender pearls, 64 eyes of ender, and 64 blaze rods)
v0.3.4 nether drop tweaks (all enderman drop a bunch of pearls, wither skeletons always drop skulls, and blazes drop a lot of blaze rods)
v0.3.5 ore drop tweaks (netherite now drops a lot of netherite ingots)
v0.3.5.1 tweaked messages (made you say something when entering the nether)
v0.6 easy ender dragon and text tweaks (made the ender dragon die when you enter the end and made it say something)
v0.8 void can't kill (teleports you 100 blocks in the air if you fall in the void)
v0.9 enchanted elytra (when you get an elytra, hold it in your hand and it will be enchanted)
v1 torches & ladder no longer break (basic bug fix, before, it would think you were suffocating in a ladder or torch and break them)

Here's everything that's been changed since last release.
